$Comment: The disenchanter's kit's tile on the buff bar while all four armor pieces are on and the Disenchanter's Grimoire is in hand (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/RPG_Disenchanters_Kit.json names it as the third tier's Badge), the grimoire's icon.
